items.title: Big holes in grass ! Some on the football pitch been filled in with solid but loads of deep ones still in the park - HALF A JOB DONE ! Need filling I. ASAP ! Lots people and dogs falling in them . While you’re there. The pathway has massive cracks and some small stiles inserted 2 weeks ago but not all and still waiting for pitch over - again HALF A JOB ! The grass, the path is UNSAFE and a big risk of INJURY ,slips trips and falls small children going to school . NEEDS ATTENTION ASAP ! How much would it cost you if someone reports a sprain or injury ?????>. My guess is a lot ! You have a duty of care !!! Do it , do it now !
